summary_en: Kiran, a working professional in Hyderabad, called to learn about Python, SQL, and PowerBI courses with evening or weekend schedules. The agent explained that an eight-week Python with Data Analytics course costs ₹8,999, is open to graduates or final-year students with basic computer knowledge, and includes study materials with no hidden or extra charges. Installment discounts are unavailable. The course provides resume building, interview preparation, job referrals, assessments, and hands-on live projects, but no formal exams or job guarantee. The agent stated that the course currently offered is only Python with Data Analytics and could not provide details about advanced modules or adding SQL/PowerBI. Weekday evening classes run Monday to Friday from 8:00 PM to 9:00 PM; weekend classes run every Saturday and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM, with no timing flexibility. Kiran provided his name, email, and graduate qualification, and after an initial uncertainty the agent confirmed that the enquiry was saved. He raised concerns about the price, lack of installment discounts, absence of schedule flexibility, and no job guarantee. He did not register for the offered free demo or admission counselling, stating that he had not decided yet. The call ended politely after his questions were addressed.
